scripts.delpoy-dev:
rsync -avzh --delete dist biocomp@persefone:/var/www/apicuron-dev/ && echo "
Done with deploy-dev!"
scripts.deploy-prod-quick: (colC='\033[0;36m';colN='\033[0m'; echo ${colC}Running npm build ...${colN} && npm run build && echo ${colC}Rsyncing dist ...${colN} && rsync -avh --delete dist/* biocomp@persefone:/var/www/apicuron/dist/ && echo ${colC}Done with deploy-prod-quick!${colC})
scripts.deploy-prod: ssh -tt biocomp@persefone 'bash -c "cd /var/www/apicuron/ && echo -e \${colC}Running git stash, pull ...\${colN} && git stash && git pull && echo -e \${colC}Deleting node_modules ...\${colN} && rm -rf node_modules && echo -e \${colC}Running npm install ...\${colN} && nvm use && npm install && echo -e \${colC}Running npm run build ...\${colN} && npm run build && echo -e \${colC}Done with deploy-prod!\${colN}"'
